desc: Generic localized UI/system string table (pool layout: id + 5 x (char count, string pointer)). Texts are looked up by id from code (e.g. 0x2c10/0x2c11 = 11280/11281). PC exe picks the slot by game language (0=JP,1=EN,2=FR); language ids 3/4 are remapped to slot 1, so CHN/KOR slots appear unused on PC. Field names kept as name_* (used by test_roundtrip edit test).

fields.name: name_JP_len
fields.desc: character count of name_JP (auto-computed on write)
